Intel: chunk multi-function Python source into multiple pieces

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.treesitterlanguagepack.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var configJson = "{\"chunk_max_size\":30,\"language\":\"python\"}";
        var config = JsonUtil.fromJson(configJson, ProcessConfig.class);
        var result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("def alpha():\n    pass\n\ndef beta():\n    pass\n\ndef gamma():\n    pass\n\ndef delta():\n    pass\n", config);
        System.out.println(result.language());
        System.out.println(result.metrics().totalLines());
        System.out.println(result.chunks());
    }
}
```
